notes.title: Let's Learn Lingít - Engine Update
notes.content: The latest patch is to get the language games back up in running to their functional state. This update should fix any game breaking bugs and will allow users to use the placenames map again without issue.

notes.title: Major Update: 18,000 Practice Cues Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Today marks a significant milestone in our journey together. I am thrilled to announce that we've added 10,000 practice cues to the game, a monumental step towards completing all audio cues. This update brings a wealth of new content, specifically enriching the Verb and Oratory floors, designed to enhance your learning and gameplay experience.

As a developer, my journey has been one of passionate learning and relentless dedication. Despite being at the beginning of this path, my commitment to laying a solid foundation and reciting almost every word in the game has been unwavering. It's been a journey filled with challenges and discoveries, and I'm excited to share the fruits of this labor with you.

A Note on Perfection: In the process of adding these cues, I've given my all to ensure accuracy and clarity. However, given the sheer volume and my ongoing learning curve, some mispronunciations may have slipped through. I invite you to view this update as a First Edition—a solid base that we will continue to refine and improve together. Your feedback and insights are invaluable to this process, and I look forward to your contributions in making the game even better.

Let's Connect: I encourage you to dive into the new content and share your experiences. Your feedback, whether on pronunciation, the learning curve, or new features you'd like to see, is eagerly awaited. Together, we can ensure that our game remains a dynamic and enriching learning environment.

Thank you for your unwavering support and enthusiasm. Here's to the many more milestones we'll achieve together!

Gunalchéesh,

Da Ka Xeen
Joshua Clark

notes.title: Audio Update 2 and Alphabet Widget
notes.content:
Added 1500 more of my practice audio cues to the Say it in Tlingit floor. Bringing total audio cue count to 4600.

Added a simple alphabet sound widget (ABC widget on left) to the showrooms and built it into the glossary. 

Continuing to fix cosmetic things moving forward. I have one more update planned for audio which is to get the cues directly into the glossary. I have a volunteer to do the English audio cues which should assist the younger learners. 

Overall, it's way beyond my original vision for the project and have kept costs minimal to non-existent so I am a happy camper. Gunalchéesh for joining me on my language learning journey :)

notes.title: Audio Update 1
notes.content:
Now incorporated are AUDIO CUES in the showroom. Have fixed numerous errors in the process and there are now audio cues in the first half of the showrooms (3100 audio cues so far). Kindly reminding everyone I am a beginning speaker trying to lay a strong programming foundation.

I will work on doing videos of the Say it in Tlingit phrases next and will eventually incorporate these audio and video cues right into the glossary. Those videos are linked on main page with the excel sheet.

Still not sure how far I am taking this, just know I am a Tlingit man that doesn't know how to speak the language and am going to keep pushing this until I can say I put my best foot forward. Gunalchéesh for joining the journey with me :)

If you want a direct copy of the application you MUST email letslearnlingit@gmail.com and make that request.

notes.title: Placenames + Verbs + Oratory
notes.content:
Massive update brings total content to over 12,000 translations/interpretations. Along with that, the following features and/or modules were added:

[list]
[*] Placenames Module - All Southeast Alaska placenames using google data to EXPLORE
[*] Oratory - These are pictures of my excel notes pertaining to various Tlingit oratory references and books. It's the data from these Tlingit sources. For the additional narratives, I recommend buying the resources directly. Only disclaimer is that I had trouble discerning the i from the í in the Dauenhauer publications. 
[*] Verb Search - Below the dictionary quick search icon in left of showroom levels, there is an hourglass with a V on it where you can now search specifically for verbs
[*] Verb Dictionary Tab - I've added the VERB DICTIONARY to the glossary tab and have generated more images to go with it. Learners should go here when seeing how these verbs are used in sentences. 
[/list]

Gunalchéesh for your patience while I wrapped up the final content I am willing to include. I currently don't plan on adding anything further. Please reach out to me via email for any GAME BREAKING bugs that are causing anyone serious duress. Otherwise, happy learning and I wish you best of luck on your Tlingit journey :)

notes.title: July 2023 Update
notes.content:
3 New Games have been added to gamify the language:

Jigsaw Puzzle - Shares same card library as memory template

Fetch - Play fetch with a German Shepherd. Use the fetch command and click the ball to throw it. 

Hidden Object 3D - A 3D version of iSpy/Hidden Object game

Please email if you are having any troubles or concerns.
